name: 02_controller_manager_empty
description: The 30-byte controller manager record of New City (11): version 1, the 24-hour clock 0x0A019318 of class 0xA7E7F929, times (0.0 h, day 0) twice, no controllers, no automaton sets. Read sets the loaded flag; the record re-encodes byte-identically. A cut record fails.
